answer: The inlet schedule is applied in signal and shale makes public each instalment. A payout is split thus 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3582 identities would post 1079 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
